description: This file declares functions related tojit decomposition registry, allowing registration, retrieval, and execution of decomposition graphs for specific function schemas within PyTorch's JIT compiler.

methods.name: GetDecomposition
methods.description: Retrieves an optional shared pointer to a decomposition graph for a given function schema.

methods.name: RegisterDecomposition
methods.description: Registers a decomposition graph for a specific function schema.

methods.name: RunDecompositions
methods.description: Executes registered decompositions on the provided graph.

methods.name: GetDecompositionFunction
methods.description: Fetches a pointer to the decomposition function associated with a schema.

methods.name: GetDecompositionExecutor
methods.description: Returns a function object that executes the decomposition for a given schema or literal.

methods.name: run_jit_decomposition
methods.description: Performs JIT decomposition on a specified operator within a given stack.

methods.name: has_jit_decomposition
methods.description: Checks whether a decomposition exists for a specific function schema.
